messages.text: Material control needs one defensible decision for relay lot transfer by 2026-01-15; a faster or broader action has value only if it remains inside lot, ownership, transit, and destination reservation must remain valid.
I found 83 EA on the header, but the workbook has separate observation and exclusion rows. Please do not net from this message.

Approval AP-0056 permits one control-compliant action on NS-000056 up to 73 EA, provided lot, ownership, transit, and destination reservation must remain valid. It does not select an option in advance and does not authorize broader records or buy_new_supply.
Protected load remains non-displaceable. The calendar for interplant handling and transit window is the source for internal windows; the supplier response covers only its stated alternative.
Revision R10 and the CASE-057 record are visible in search but are not applicable to CASE-056.

Required closeout records: record the selected option, committed completion, and binding constraint in the existing Control outcome cell; and prepare the reply in the existing email thread and leave it as a draft for review; do not send it. Verify the persisted record after the Oracle call.
